#pivoting and fixing year + other problems

```{r}
gapminder_life_expectancy<- gapminder_life_expectancy %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(name,geo),
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "life_expectancy") %>% 
  mutate(year= str_remove(year, "X"))
```

```{r}
Child_mortalityG<-Child_mortalityG %>% 
pivot_longer(-c(name,geo),
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "cild_mortality") %>% 
  mutate(year= str_remove(year, "X")) 
```

```{r}
co2_emissions<- co2_emissions %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(geo,name),
               names_to = "year",
              values_to = "Co2_emissions")
```

```{r}
pop<- Pop %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(geo,name),
               names_to = "year",
              values_to = "population")
```

```{r}
child_per_woman<- child_per_woman %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(geo,name),
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "child_per_woman")
```

#joining data tables

```{r}
gp<-full_join(Child_mortalityG, gapminder_life_expectancy, by= c("name", "geo","year"))
```

```{r}
gp2<-full_join(gp, co2_emissions, by= c("name", "geo","year"))
```

```{r}
gp3<-full_join(gp2,pop, by= c("name", "geo","year"))
```

```{r}
gapminder<-full_join(gp3,child_per_woman )
```

```{r}
gapminder<- gapminder %>% 
  filter(year>= "1915", year<="2025")
```


#final data set

```{r}
gapminder
```

```{r}
write.csv(gapminder, file="gapminder.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```
